_comment: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json). MERGE this into your existing file, do not blindly overwrite it. Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_HOME with your real home directory - hook commands do not expand ~ or $HOME. Delete the permissions block if you are not installing the four lean-context converter CLIs. Remove this _comment key before use.
_autoContinue_comment: Independent of which ruleset you run, and worth having either way. The CLI's own description: 'When a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, wait for the limit to reset and continue the task automatically. When off, the limit dialog offers the wait as a choice instead.' The session has to stay open, and it can still pause for permission prompts. Lower-priority mode is a different thing and cannot be set here: the client is offered it in the rate-limit response headers, so it only exists once a limit has actually been hit - accept it from the dialog, or reopen the menu with /rate-limit-options.
